query: What precise timing window will define predictor preceding outcome (max minutes/hours between AG/albumin and first lactate), and how will we test robustness across alternative timing windows?

response.query: What precise timing window will define predictor preceding outcome (max minutes/hours between AG/albumin and first lactate), and how will we test robustness across alternative timing windows?
response.answer: The precise timing window is up to 6 hours between AG/albumin and first lactate measurement. Robustness across alternative windows will be tested via statistical analysis of outcomes.
